## Company

- Chinese name: 扬州宇元新材有限公司
- English name: Yangzhou Cosmorigin Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
- Brand: CosmoOrigin / 宇元新材
- Location: Room 609, No. 213 West Kaifa Road, Hanjiang District, Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China
- Website: https://cosmorigin.com
- Contact: contact@cosmorigin.com, +86 185 7841 2005

## Summary

CosmoOrigin develops flexible luminescent materials and custom light-material solution packages. Core materials include luminescent paint, luminescent fibers, electroluminescent wire, glow films, and 3D-printing luminescent additives. Main application scenarios include mobility and automotive parts, smart agriculture, emergency safety, cultural tourism, creative installations, and material validation projects.

宇元新材专注柔性发光材料研发与规模化应用，产品方向包括发光油漆、发光纤维丝、电致发光线缆、发光膜/薄膜与 3D 打印发光辅材，服务交通出行、智慧农业、应急安全、文旅夜游、艺术装置与联合研发验证场景。
